resources.string: Folder backup
Backup folder
Choose device storage, an SD card or a document provider.
Backup password
Encrypts backups independently of the master password. Keep it safe. Leave blank to keep the current password.
Confirm backup password
Automatic backup
Checks every 12 hours. Backups wait for an unlocked, visible Monica session.
Back up after changes
Waits 2 minutes after editing; at least 15 minutes between backups.
Backups to keep
1–1000 automatic backups. Manual backups are permanent. Cloud providers keep recent files for 48 hours and at least two older generations; the total may exceed this limit.
Cloud upload is managed by the document provider. Readback does not confirm remote upload.
Encrypted Monica local-data backups in the existing ZIP format. External vaults and connection settings are excluded. Restore through Import data.
Folder selected
Written and verified by the file provider
Backup verified; old backup cleanup deferred.
Waiting for Monica to be unlocked and visible. Existing backups are preserved.
Folder access is unavailable. Select the folder again; existing backups are preserved.
Some data could not be backed up completely. No backup was published or rotated. Check unreadable records and hardware-bound Passkeys.
Backup failed. Existing backups are preserved; check folder access and storage space.
Incomplete or unverified — not a successful backup
Manual backup · kept permanently
Restore backup
